     acoustic chamber fluid channel. Transducer elements comprising lead zirconate titanate (PZT-5A) piezoelectric

         k_w       = Acoustic acoustic wavenumber = 2 * pi / lambda_ac = omega_ac / c_medium [rad / m]
         omega_ac  = Angular acoustic frequency = 2 * pi * f_ac [rad / s]

     where:

        rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s := rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s + rCycleTime_s;
    ELSE
        rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s := MAX(0.0, rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s - (rCycleTime_s * 0.5));
        rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s := MAX(0.0, rVCD_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s - (rCycleTime_s * 0.5));

    IF ABS(rDO_Polaro1_Pct - rDO_Polaro2_Pct) > rDO_DevThreshold_Pct THEN
        rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s := rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s + rCycleTime_s;
        rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s := rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s + rCycleTime_s;
    ELSE
        rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s := MAX(0.0, rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s - (rCycleTime_s * 0.5));
        rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s := MAX(0.0, rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s - (rCycleTime_s * 0.5));
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Latch out degraded DO channels exceeding 20.0 s continuous discrepancy *)
IF rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch1_s > 20.0 THEN bDO_Ch1_Healthy := FALSE; END_IF;
IF rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch2_s > 20.0 THEN bDO_Ch2_Healthy := FALSE; END_IF;
IF rDO_DiscrepTimer_Ch3_s > 20.0 THEN bDO_Ch3_Healthy := FALSE; END_IF;

(* Count available healthy DO channels *)
iDO_HealthyChannelCount := 0;
IF bDO_Ch1_Healthy THEN iDO_HealthyChannelCount := iDO_HealthyChannelCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bDO_Ch2_Healthy THEN iDO_HealthyChannelCount := iDO_HealthyChannelCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bDO_Ch3_Healthy THEN iDO_HealthyChannelCount := iDO_HealthyChannelCount + 1; END_IF;

(* DO Voting Execution *)
IF iDO_HealthyChannelCount = 3 THEN
    IF (rDO_Optical_Pct >= rDO_Polaro1_Pct AND rDO_Optical_Pct <= rDO_Polaro2_Pct) OR
       (rDO_Optical_Pct <= rDO_Polaro1_Pct AND rDO_Optical_Pct >= rDO_Polaro2_Pct) THEN
        rVoted_DO_Pct := rDO_Optical_Pct;
    ELSIF (rDO_Polaro1_Pct >= rDO_Optical_Pct AND rDO_Polaro1_Pct <= rDO_Polaro2_Pct) OR
          (rDO_Polaro1_Pct <= rDO_Optical_Pct AND rDO_Polaro1_Pct >= rDO_Polaro2_Pct) THEN
        rVoted_DO_Pct := rDO_Polaro1_Pct;
    ELSE
        rVoted_DO_Pct := rDO_Polaro2_Pct;
    END_IF;
    bAlarm_DO_SensorDiscrepancy := FALSE;
ELSIF iDO_HealthyChannelCount = 2 THEN
    bAlarm_DO_SensorDiscrepancy := TRUE;
    IF bDO_Ch1_Healthy AND bDO_Ch2_Healthy THEN
        rVoted_DO_Pct := (rDO_Optical_Pct + rDO_Polaro1_Pct) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bDO_Ch1_Healthy AND bDO_Ch3_Healthy THEN
        rVoted_DO_Pct := (rDO_Optical_Pct + rDO_Polaro2_Pct) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVoted_DO_Pct := (rDO_Polaro1_Pct + rDO_Polaro2_Pct) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iDO_HealthyChannelCount = 1 THEN
    bAlarm_DO_SensorDiscrepancy := TRUE;
    IF bDO_Ch1_Healthy THEN
        rVoted_DO_Pct := rDO_Optical_Pct;
    ELSIF bDO_Ch2_Healthy THEN
        rVoted_DO_Pct := rDO_Polaro1_Pct;
    ELSE
        rVoted_DO_Pct := rDO_Polaro2_Pct;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bAlarm_DO_SensorDiscrepancy := TRUE;
    rVoted_DO_Pct := rTargetDO_Pct + aStateEstimate[2];
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SEGMENT 3: ANALOG SIGNAL CONDITIONING & EWMA DIGITAL FILTERING                                                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Exponentially Weighted Moving Average (EWMA) filtering eliminates high-frequency measurement noise *)
rFilt_VCD_Cells_mL     := (rFilterAlpha_Slow * rVoted_VCD_Cells_mL) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Slow) * rFilt_VCD_Cells_mL);
rFilt_DO_Pct           := (rFilterAlpha_Fast * rVoted_DO_Pct)       + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Fast) * rFilt_DO_Pct);
rFilt_pH               := (rFilterAlpha_Slow * rBioreactor_pH)      + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Slow) * rFilt_pH);
rFilt_Temp_degC        := (rFilterAlpha_Slow * rBioreactorTemp_degC)+ ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Slow) * rFilt_Temp_degC);
rFilt_ChamberTemp_degC := (rFilterAlpha_Fast * rAcousticChamberTemp_degC) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Fast) * rFilt_ChamberTemp_degC);
rFilt_RF_Power_W       := (rFilterAlpha_Fast * (rAcousticSep_RF_Voltage_V * rAcousticSep_RF_Current_A * COS(rAcousticSep_Phase_deg * 3.14159265 / 180.0)))
                          + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Fast) * rFilt_RF_Power_W);
rFilt_RF_Phase_deg     := (rFilterAlpha_Fast * rAcousticSep_Phase_deg) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Fast) * rFilt_RF_Phase_deg);
rFilt_OffGas_O2_Pct    := (rFilterAlpha_Fast * rOffGas_O2_Pct)         + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Fast) * rFilt_OffGas_O2_Pct);
rFilt_OffGas_CO2_Pct   := (rFilterAlpha_Fast * rOffGas_CO2_Pct)        + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Fast) * rFilt_OffGas_CO2_Pct);
rFilt_Agitation_RPM    := (rFilterAlpha_Slow * rAgitationSpeed_RPM)    + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Slow) * rFilt_Agitation_RPM);

(* Real-time ultrasonic transducer electrical impedance magnitude [Ohm] *)
IF rAcousticSep_RF_Current_A > 0.05 THEN
    rAcousticImpedanceMagnitude_Ohm := rAcousticSep_RF_Voltage_V / rAcousticSep_RF_Current_A;
ELSE
    rAcousticImpedanceMagnitude_Ohm := 50.0;
END_IF;

(* Acoustic thermal dissipation estimation into fluid stream [W] *)
rAcousticThermalDissipation_W := MAX(0.0, rFilt_RF_Power_W - rAcousticReflectedPower_W) * 0.82;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SEGMENT 4: OFF-GAS MASS SPECTROMETRY & METABOLIC RESPIROMETRIC ESTIMATOR                                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Calculate total inlet gas flow rate across spargers [sccm] *)
rTempSum := rMicroSpargeO2_Flow_sccm + rMacroSpargeAir_Flow_sccm + rMacroSpargeCO2_Flow_sccm;

IF (rTempSum > 50.0) AND (rBioreactorWorkingVol_L > 10.0) THEN
    (* Inlet mole fractions of O2 and CO2 *)
    rTempSum := MAX(rTempSum, 1.0);
    (* Fractional gas composition *)
    rInnovationVector[1] := ((rMicroSpargeO2_Flow_sccm * 1.0) + (rMacroSpargeAir_Flow_sccm * c_rO2FractionAir)) / rTempSum; (* y_O2_in *)
    rInnovationVector[2] := ((rMacroSpargeCO2_Flow_sccm * 1.0) + (rMacroSpargeAir_Flow_sccm * c_rCO2FractionAir)) / rTempSum; (* y_CO2_in *)
    
    (* Inert gas fraction (Nitrogen + Argon balance) *)
    rInnovationVector[3] := 1.0 - rInnovationVector[1] - rInnovationVector[2]; (* y_Inert_in *)
    rInnovationVector[4] := 1.0 - (rFilt_OffGas_O2_Pct * 0.01) - (rFilt_OffGas_CO2_Pct * 0.01); (* y_Inert_out *)
    
    IF rInnovationVector[4] > 0.10 THEN
        (* Inert expansion factor F_gas_out / F_gas_in *)
        rTempSum := (rInnovationVector[3] / rInnovationVector[4]);
        
        (* Oxygen Uptake Rate (OUR) [mmol / L / h] *)
        (* Conversions: sccm -> L/min (/ 1000) -> mol/h (* 60 / 22.414) -> mmol/h (* 1000) *)
        rEstimated_OUR_mmol_L_h := ((rMicroSpargeO2_Flow_sccm + rMacroSpargeAir_Flow_sccm + rMacroSpargeCO2_Flow_sccm) * 60.0 / (c_rMolarVolume_L_mol * rBioreactorWorkingVol_L))
                                   * (rInnovationVector[1] - ((rFilt_OffGas_O2_Pct * 0.01) * rTempSum));
        rEstimated_OUR_mmol_L_h := MAX(0.0, rEstimated_OUR_mmol_L_h);
        
        (* Carbon Dioxide Evolution Rate (CER) [mmol / L / h] *)
        rEstimated_CER_mmol_L_h := ((rMicroSpargeO2_Flow_sccm + rMacroSpargeAir_Flow_sccm + rMacroSpargeCO2_Flow_sccm) * 60.0 / (c_rMolarVolume_L_mol * rBioreactorWorkingVol_L))
                                   * (((rFilt_OffGas_CO2_Pct * 0.01) * rTempSum) - rInnovationVector[2]);
        rEstimated_CER_mmol_L_h := MAX(0.0, rEstimated_CER_mmol_L_h);
        
        (* Respiratory Quotient (RQ) *)
        IF rEstimated_OUR_mmol_L_h > 0.5 THEN
            rEstimated_RQ := rEstimated_CER_mmol_L_h / rEstimated_OUR_mmol_L_h;
        ELSE
            rEstimated_RQ := 0.95;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Specific Growth Rate (mu) Observer from Cell Mass Balance:
   dX_v/dt = (mu - D_bleed - D_harvest*(1-R_sep)) * X_v
   mu = (1/X_v)*(dX_v/dt) + D_bleed + D_harvest*(1-R_sep) *)
IF (rFilt_VCD_Cells_mL > 5.0E6) AND (rBioreactorWorkingVol_L > 10.0) AND (rCycleTime_s > 0.0) THEN
    (* Discrete derivative of biomass *)
    rTempSum := (rFilt_VCD_Cells_mL - rPastVCD_Cells_mL) / (rCycleTime_s * 3600.0); (* cells/mL/h *)
    
    rRollingGrowthRateBuffer[iGrowthRateBufferIndex] := (rTempSum / rFilt_VCD_Cells_mL)
                                                     + ((rActualBleedFlow_L_day / rBioreactorWorkingVol_L) / 24.0)
                                                     + (((rPerfusionHarvestFlow_L_day / rBioreactorWorkingVol_L) * (1.0 - (rAcousticRetentionEfficiency_Pct * 0.01))) / 24.0);
    
    (* Circular buffer advance *)
    iGrowthRateBufferIndex := iGrowthRateBufferIndex + 1;
    IF iGrowthRateBufferIndex > 10 THEN
        iGrowthRateBufferIndex := 1;
    END_IF;
    
    (* Smoothed specific growth rate mu [1/h] *)
    rCalculated_mu_h_inv := 0.0;
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 10 DO
        rCalculated_mu_h_inv := rCalculated_mu_h_inv + rRollingGrowthRateBuffer[iIdx];
    END_FOR;
    rCalculated_mu_h_inv := rCalculated_mu_h_inv * 0.10;
    rCalculated_mu_h_inv := LIMIT(0.0, rCalculated_mu_h_inv, 0.065); (* Realistic mammalian bound: doubling time >= 10.6 h *)
END_IF;
rPastVCD_Cells_mL := rFilt_VCD_Cells_mL;

(* Dynamic Volumetric Oxygen Mass Transfer Coefficient (kLa) Estimator [1/h] *)
IF (rTargetDO_Pct - rFilt_DO_Pct) > 1.0 THEN
    (* Broth saturated O2 concentration at 37.0 deg C approx 0.218 mmol/L *)
    rEstimated_kLa_h_inv := (rEstimated_OUR_mmol_L_h + ((rFilt_DO_Pct - rPastDO_Pct) * 0.01 * 0.218 / (rCycleTime_s / 3600.0)))
                            / MAX(0.01, (100.0 - rFilt_DO_Pct) * 0.01 * 0.218);
    rEstimated_kLa_h_inv := LIMIT(2.0, rEstimated_kLa_h_inv, 120.0);
ELSE
    rEstimated_kLa_h_inv := 25.0;
END_IF;
rPastDO_Pct := rFilt_DO_Pct;

(* Dynamic Acoustic Retention Efficiency Estimation *)
IF (rFreshMediaFeedFlow_L_day > 10.0) AND (rFilt_VCD_Cells_mL > 1.0E6) THEN
    (* Acoustic efficiency based on harvest clarity and bleed balance *)
    rAcousticRetentionEfficiency_Pct := 100.0 * (1.0 - (rActualBleedFlow_L_day / (rFreshMediaFeedFlow_L_day + 0.001)) * (rTargetVCD_Cells_mL / (rFilt_VCD_Cells_mL + 0.001)) * 0.08);
    rAcousticRetentionEfficiency_Pct := LIMIT(92.0, rAcousticRetentionEfficiency_Pct, 99.9);
ELSE
    rAcousticRetentionEfficiency_Pct := 99.5;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SEGMENT 5: ACOUSTIC SEPARATOR RESONANCE PHASE-LOCKED LOOP (PLL) & EXTREMUM SEEKING                                 *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF bAcousticSepCmd AND (iActiveState >= 30) AND (iActiveState <= 50) THEN
    (* 5.1: Phase angle error PI regulation towards anti-resonance zero crossing *)
    IF bResonanceTrackingCmd THEN
        (* Phase angle error accumulation *)
        rAcousticPhase_Integrator := rAcousticPhase_Integrator + (rFilt_RF_Phase_deg * rCycleTime_s);
        rAcousticPhase_Integrator := LIMIT(-50.0, rAcousticPhase_Integrator, 50.0);
        
        (* PI frequency correction offset *)
        rAcousticFreq_Dither_kHz := (rAcousticPhase_Kp * rFilt_RF_Phase_deg) + (rAcousticPhase_Ki * rAcousticPhase_Integrator);
        
        (* 5.2: Extremum seeking impedance gradient tracking *)
        IF (rAcousticImpedanceMagnitude_Ohm - rPastImpedanceMagnitude_Ohm) < -1.5 THEN
            (* Impedance dropped: reverse frequency search direction *)
            bExtremumSeekingDirection := NOT bExtremumSeekingDirection;
        END_IF;
        
        IF bExtremumSeekingDirection THEN
            rAcousticFreq_Current_kHz := rAcousticFreq_Current_kHz + (rAcousticFreq_Step_kHz * 0.1);
        ELSE
            rAcousticFreq_Current_kHz := rAcousticFreq_Current_kHz - (rAcousticFreq_Step_kHz * 0.1);
        END_IF;
        
        (* Synthesize commanded frequency *)
        rCmdAcousticFrequency_kHz := rAcousticFreq_Current_kHz + rAcousticFreq_Dither_kHz;
        rCmdAcousticFrequency_kHz := LIMIT(c_rMinAcousticFreq_kHz, rCmdAcousticFrequency_kHz, c_rMaxAcousticFreq_kHz);
        
        (* Verify stable resonance lock condition *)
        IF (ABS(rFilt_RF_Phase_deg) <= 3.5) AND (rAcousticReflectedPower_W <= 4.0) THEN
            rResonanceLockTimer_s := rResonanceLockTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
            IF rResonanceLockTimer_s >= 4.0 THEN
                bAcousticResonanceLocked := TRUE;
                bAlarm_AcousticResonanceLost := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            rResonanceLockTimer_s := 0.0;
            bAcousticResonanceLocked := FALSE;
            IF rStateTimeInStep_s > 60.0 THEN
                bAlarm_AcousticResonanceLost := TRUE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        (* Manual default frequency *)
        rCmdAcousticFrequency_kHz := c_rNominalAcousticFreq_kHz;
        bAcousticResonanceLocked  := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    
    (* 5.3: Transducer thermal derating to protect cell viability *)
    IF rFilt_ChamberTemp_degC >= c_rWarningChamberTemp_degC THEN
        (* Linear derating factor between 38.5 deg C and 39.8 deg C *)
        rTempSum := 1.0 - ((rFilt_ChamberTemp_degC - c_rWarningChamberTemp_degC) / (c_rMaxChamberTemp_degC - c_rWarningChamberTemp_degC));
        rTempSum := LIMIT(0.25, rTempSum, 1.0);
    ELSE
        rTempSum := 1.0;
    END_IF;
    
    (* 5.4: Acoustic duty cycle pulse & settling timer *)
    rAcousticPulseTimer_s := rAcousticPulseTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
    IF rAcousticPulseTimer_s < 55.0 THEN
        (* Active standing wave separation phase *)
        bAcousticPulseActive      := TRUE;
        rCmdAcousticPower_W       := (65.0 + aControlInputCurrent[4]) * rTempSum;
        rCmdAcousticDutyCycle_Pct := 91.6;
    ELSIF rAcousticPulseTimer_s < 60.0 THEN
        (* Relaxed sedimentation phase: cluster settling back into bioreactor downcomer *)
        bAcousticPulseActive      := FALSE;
        rCmdAcousticPower_W       := 0.0;
        rCmdAcousticDutyCycle_Pct := 91.6;
    ELSE
        rAcousticPulseTimer_s := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    
    rPastImpedanceMagnitude_Ohm := rAcousticImpedanceMagnitude_Ohm;
    rPastAcousticFreq_kHz       := rCmdAcousticFrequency_kHz;
ELSE
    rCmdAcousticFrequency_kHz := c_rNominalAcousticFreq_kHz;
    rCmdAcousticPower_W       := 0.0;
    rCmdAcousticDutyCycle_Pct := 0.0;
    bAcousticResonanceLocked  := FALSE;
    rResonanceLockTimer_s     := 0.0;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SEGMENT 6: 4x4 CYBER-PHYSICAL STATE-SPACE OBSERVER (KALMAN FILTER ENGINE)                                          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* State vector physical deviations:
   x_1 = Delta_VCD     [cells/mL]
   x_2 = Delta_DO      [% air sat]
   x_3 = Delta_pCO2    [mmHg]
   x_4 = Delta_T_ch    [deg C] *)

(* Measurement Vector Formulation *)
aMeasuredOutputVector[1] := rFilt_VCD_Cells_mL - rTargetVCD_Cells_mL;
aMeasuredOutputVector[2] := rFilt_DO_Pct - rTargetDO_Pct;
aMeasuredOutputVector[3] := (rEstimated_CER_mmol_L_h * 2.85) - c_rTargetpCO2_mmHg; (* pCO2 proxy correlation *)
aMeasuredOutputVector[4] := rFilt_ChamberTemp_degC - rTargetTemp_degC;

(* Deterministic Initialization of Discrete 4x4 State-Space Plant Matrices *)
(* Transition Matrix A_d (Cycle time T_s = 1.0 s) *)
aMatrixA[1,1] := 0.99988; aMatrixA[1,2] := 0.00000; aMatrixA[1,3] :=-0.00005; aMatrixA[1,4] := 0.00000;
aMatrixA[2,1] :=-0.00012; aMatrixA[2,2] := 0.98500; aMatrixA[2,3] := 0.00000; aMatrixA[2,4] :=-0.00150;
aMatrixA[3,1] := 0.00018; aMatrixA[3,2] := 0.00000; aMatrixA[3,3] := 0.99200; aMatrixA[3,4] := 0.00080;
aMatrixA[4,1] := 0.00000; aMatrixA[4,2] := 0.00000; aMatrixA[4,3] := 0.00000; aMatrixA[4,4] := 0.97800;

(* Input Coupling Matrix B_d (Actuator gains per engineering unit) *)
aMatrixB[1,1] :=-0.00285; aMatrixB[1,2] := 0.00000; aMatrixB[1,3] := 0.00000; aMatrixB[1,4] := 0.00045;
aMatrixB[2,1] := 0.00000; aMatrixB[2,2] := 0.00840; aMatrixB[2,3] := 0.00180; aMatrixB[2,4] := 0.00000;
aMatrixB[3,1] :=-0.00040; aMatrixB[3,2] := 0.00000; aMatrixB[3,3] :=-0.00650; aMatrixB[3,4] := 0.00000;
aMatrixB[4,1] := 0.00000; aMatrixB[4,2] := 0.00000; aMatrixB[4,3] := 0.00000; aMatrixB[4,4] := 0.02450;

(* Output Coupling Matrix C_d *)
aMatrixC[1,1] := 1.0; aMatrixC[1,2] := 0.0; aMatrixC[1,3] := 0.0; aMatrixC[1,4] := 0.0;
aMatrixC[2,1] := 0.0; aMatrixC[2,2] := 1.0; aMatrixC[2,3] := 0.0; aMatrixC[2,4] := 0.0;
aMatrixC[3,1] := 0.0; aMatrixC[3,2] := 0.0; aMatrixC[3,3] := 1.0; aMatrixC[3,4] := 0.0;
aMatrixC[4,1] := 0.0; aMatrixC[4,2] := 0.0; aMatrixC[4,3] := 0.0; aMatrixC[4,4] := 1.0;

(* Steady-State Kalman Observer Gain Matrix K_kalman *)
aMatrixKalmanGain[1,1] := 0.1250; aMatrixKalmanGain[1,2] := 0.0000; aMatrixKalmanGain[1,3] :=-0.0012; aMatrixKalmanGain[1,4] := 0.0000;
aMatrixKalmanGain[2,1] :=-0.0005; aMatrixKalmanGain[2,2] := 0.2200; aMatrixKalmanGain[2,3] := 0.0000; aMatrixKalmanGain[2,4] :=-0.0045;
aMatrixKalmanGain[3,1] := 0.0015; aMatrixKalmanGain[3,2] := 0.0000; aMatrixKalmanGain[3,3] := 0.1850; aMatrixKalmanGain[3,4] := 0.0022;
aMatrixKalmanGain[4,1] := 0.0000; aMatrixKalmanGain[4,2] := 0.0000; aMatrixKalmanGain[4,3] := 0.0000; aMatrixKalmanGain[4,4] := 0.3100;

(* Step 6.1: Prior State Prediction x_pred = A * x_est + B * u_past *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
    aStatePredict[iIdx] := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        aStatePredict[iIdx] := aStatePredict[iIdx] + (aMatrixA[iIdx, jIdx] * aStateEstimate[jIdx])
                                                   + (aMatrixB[iIdx, jIdx] * aControlInputPast[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Step 6.2: Measurement Innovation Vector y_innov = y_meas - C * x_pred *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrixC[iIdx, jIdx] * aStatePredict[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    aInnovationVector[iIdx] := aMeasuredOutputVector[iIdx] - rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Step 6.3: Corrected State Estimation x_est = x_pred + K * y_innov *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrixKalmanGain[iIdx, jIdx] * aInnovationVector[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    aStateEstimate[iIdx] := aStatePredict[iIdx] + rTempSum;
END_FOR;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SEGMENT 7: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) PROJECTED GRADIENT DESCENT QP SOLVER                                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Objective: min J(Delta u) = 0.5 * Delta u^T * H * Delta u + g^T * Delta u
   subject to actuator rate and amplitude constraints *)

(* MPC Weighting Factors *)
aWeightQ[1] := 1.85E-12; (* VCD tracking error penalty *)
aWeightQ[2] := 0.450;    (* DO tracking error penalty *)
aWeightQ[3] := 0.120;    (* pCO2 accumulation penalty *)
aWeightQ[4] := 0.850;    (* Chamber temperature elevation penalty *)

aWeightR[1] := 0.085;    (* Bleed pump movement suppression *)
aWeightR[2] := 0.00045;  (* Oxygen flow movement suppression *)
aWeightR[3] := 0.00015;  (* Stripping air movement suppression *)
aWeightR[4] := 0.045;    (* Acoustic power modulation penalty *)

(* Diagonal Hessian Approximation H_ii = 2 * (sum_k B_ki^2 * Q_k + R_i) *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR kIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrixB[kIdx, iIdx] * aMatrixB[kIdx, iIdx] * aWeightQ[kIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    aHessianH[iIdx, iIdx] := (2.0 * rTempSum) + aWeightR[iIdx];
    IF aHessianH[iIdx, iIdx] > 1.0E-6 THEN
        aHessianInvDiag[iIdx] := 1.0 / aHessianH[iIdx, iIdx];
    ELSE
        aHessianInvDiag[iIdx] := 1.0;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Gradient Vector Formulation g_i = 2 * sum_k B_ki * Q_k * x_est_k *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR kIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrixB[kIdx, iIdx] * aWeightQ[kIdx] * aStateEstimate[kIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    aGradientG[iIdx] := 2.0 * rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Actuator Amplitude Constraints (u_min, u_max) in physical units *)
aControlLowerBound[1] := 0.0;                        aControlUpperBound[1] := c_rMaxAllowedBleedRate_L_day;
aControlLowerBound[2] := 0.0;                        aControlUpperBound[2] := c_rMaxAllowedMicroO2_sccm;
aControlLowerBound[3] := 500.0;                      aControlUpperBound[3] := c_rMaxAllowedMacroAir_sccm;
aControlLowerBound[4] := 10.0;                       aControlUpperBound[4] := 120.0;

(* Actuator Slew Rate Constraints (Delta u_min, Delta u_max per cycle) *)
aDeltaLowerBound[1] := -2.50;                        aDeltaUpperBound[1] :=  2.50;  (* Bleed rate max +/- 2.5 L/day/s *)
aDeltaLowerBound[2] := -85.0;                        aDeltaUpperBound[2] := 125.0;  (* Micro O2 max slew sccm/s *)
aDeltaLowerBound[3] := -150.0;                       aDeltaUpperBound[3] := 150.0;  (* Macro Air max slew sccm/s *)
aDeltaLowerBound[4] := -1.50;                        aDeltaUpperBound[4] :=  1.50;  (* Acoustic power max slew W/s *)

(* Projected Gradient Descent Iterative Solver (8 Deterministic Inner Iterations) *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
    aControlDelta[iIdx] := 0.0; (* Warm start with zero increment *)
END_FOR;

FOR kIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        (* Calculate gradient component grad_i = H_ii * Delta_u_i + g_i *)
        rTempSum := (aHessianH[iIdx, iIdx] * aControlDelta[iIdx]) + aGradientG[iIdx];
        
        (* Preconditioned gradient step: Delta_u = Delta_u - alpha * H_inv * grad *)
        aControlDelta[iIdx] := aControlDelta[iIdx] - (0.45 * aHessianInvDiag[iIdx] * rTempSum);
        
        (* Project onto Slew Rate Box Constraints *)
        aControlDelta[iIdx] := LIMIT(aDeltaLowerBound[iIdx], aControlDelta[iIdx], aDeltaUpperBound[iIdx]);
        
        (* Project onto Actuator Amplitude Saturation Constraints *)
        aControlDelta[iIdx] := LIMIT(aControlLowerBound[iIdx] - aControlInputPast[iIdx],
                                    aControlDelta[iIdx],
                                    aControlUpperBound[iIdx] - aControlInputPast[iIdx]);
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Synthesize Candidate Control Actions *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
    aControlInputCurrent[iIdx] := aControlInputPast[iIdx] + aControlDelta[iIdx];
    aControlInputCurrent[iIdx] := LIMIT(aControlLowerBound[iIdx], aControlInputCurrent[iIdx], aControlUpperBound[iIdx]);
END_FOR;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SEGMENT 8: ISA-88 CONTINUOUS PERFUSION OPERATIONAL STATE MACHINE                                                   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
CASE iActiveState OF

    0: (* STATE_STANDBY_IDLE: System de-energized, waiting for master enable and safety permissive *)
        sActiveStateDescription := 'STANDBY_IDLE: System de-energized, safety permissive verified';
        bSystemReady             := bEStopOk;
        bPerfusionActive         := FALSE;
        bCellBleedActive         := FALSE;
        bOxygenationActive       := FALSE;
        bDefoulingActive         := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive      := FALSE;

        (* Neutralize Actuation Demands *)
        rCmdBleedPumpRate_L_day   := 0.0;
        rCmdHarvestPumpRate_L_day := 0.0;
        rCmdFeedPumpRate_L_day    := 0.0;
        rCmdAcousticPower_W       := 0.0;
        rCmdMicroSpargeO2_sccm    := 0.0;
        rCmdMacroSpargeAir_sccm   := 200.0; (* Baseline purge *)
        rCmdMacroSpargeCO2_sccm   := 0.0;
        rCmdHeadspaceAir_sccm     := 500.0;
        rCmdAgitationSpeed_RPM    := 0.0;

        FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
            aControlInputPast[iIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;

        (* Transition to Vessel Priming upon Enable request *)
        IF bEnableSystem AND bEStopOk THEN
            rStateTimeInStep_s := 0.0;
            iActiveState       := 10;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_VESSEL_PRIMING_AND_PARAM_EQUILIBRATION: Media heating, pH equilibration, DO 100% calibration *)
        sActiveStateDescription := 'VESSEL_PRIMING: Thermal and gas equilibration in progress';
        bSystemReady             := TRUE;
        bPerfusionActive         := FALSE;
        bCellBleedActive         := FALSE;
        bOxygenationActive       := TRUE;
        bDefoulingActive         := FALSE;

        (* Maintain mild agitation for heat transfer and bubble dispersion *)
        rCmdAgitationSpeed_RPM    := 120.0;
        rCmdHeadspaceAir_sccm     := 1000.0;
        rCmdMacroSpargeAir_sccm   := 1500.0;
        rCmdMicroSpargeO2_sccm    := 0.0;
        rCmdMacroSpargeCO2_sccm   := 0.0;
        rCmdBleedPumpRate_L_day   := 0.0;
        rCmdHarvestPumpRate_L_day := 0.0;
        rCmdFeedPumpRate_L_day    := 0.0;
        rCmdAcousticPower_W       := 0.0;

        rStateTimeInStep_s := rStateTimeInStep_s + rCycleTime_s;

        (* Verify thermal, pH, and DO stabilization criteria *)
        IF (ABS(rFilt_Temp_degC - rTargetTemp_degC) <= 0.35) AND
           (ABS(rFilt_pH - rTargetpH) <= 0.12) AND
           (rStateTimeInStep_s >= 180.0) THEN
            rStateTimeInStep_s := 0.0;
            iActiveState       := 20; (* Transition to Inoculation / Fed-Batch Growth *)
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iActiveState := 0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_INOCULATION_AND_FEDBATCH_ACCUMULATION: Exponential cellular biomass growth *)
        sActiveStateDescription := 'INOCULATION_ACCUMULATION: Biomass growing to perfusion threshold';
        bSystemReady             := TRUE;
        bPerfusionActive         := FALSE;
        bCellBleedActive         := FALSE;
        bOxygenationActive       := TRUE;
        bDefoulingActive         := FALSE;

        (* Agitation cascade linked to DO demand *)
        rCmdAgitationSpeed_RPM    := LIMIT(120.0, 150.0 + ((rTargetDO_Pct - rFilt_DO_Pct) * 4.5), c_rMaxAllowedAgitation_RPM);
        rCmdHeadspaceAir_sccm     := 1500.0;
        rCmdMacroSpargeAir_sccm   := 2000.0;
        
        (* Apply MPC oxygen sparge command *)
        IF bAutoDOCmd THEN
            rCmdMicroSpargeO2_sccm := aControlInputCurrent[2];
        ELSE
            rCmdMicroSpargeO2_sccm := 250.0;
        END_IF;

        rCmdBleedPumpRate_L_day   := 0.0;
        rCmdHarvestPumpRate_L_day := 0.0;
        rCmdFeedPumpRate_L_day    := 0.0;
        rCmdAcousticPower_W       := 0.0;

        rStateTimeInStep_s := rStateTimeInStep_s + rCycleTime_s;

        IF (rFilt_VCD_Cells_mL >= 25.0E6) AND bPerfusionModeCmd THEN

            iActiveState       := 30;

            iActiveState := 0;

        bSystemReady             := TRUE;
        bPerfusionActive         := TRUE;
        bCellBleedActive         := FALSE;
        bOxygenationActive       := TRUE;
        bDefoulingActive         := FALSE;

        rStateTimeInStep_s := rStateTimeInStep_s + rCycleTime_s;
        rTempSum := LIMIT(0.1, rStateTimeInStep_s / 120.0, 1.0);

        rCmdFeedPumpRate_L_day    := rCmdHarvestPumpRate_L_day;
        rCmdBleedPumpRate_L_day   := 0.0;

        rCmdAgitationSpeed_RPM  := LIMIT(150.0, 180.0 + ((rTargetDO_Pct - rFilt_DO_Pct) * 5.0), c_rMaxAllowedAgitation_RPM);
        rCmdMicroSpargeO2_sccm  := aControlInputCurrent[2];

        bSystemReady             := TRUE;

        rCmdAcousticPower_W := aControlInputCurrent[4];

        bCellBleedActive         := FALSE;

        rCmdHarvestPumpRate_L_day := 0.0;
        rCmdFeedPumpRate_L_day    := 0.0;

        rCmdAcousticPower_W       := 15.0; (* Low cleaning agitation power *)

        rCmdMicroSpargeO2_sccm  := aControlInputCurrent[2];

        IF rStateTimeInStep_s >= 45.0 THEN

        sActiveStateDescription := 'DEGRADATION_HOLD: Multiple sensor faults, running conservative hold';
        bSystemReady             := TRUE;

        bCellBleedActive         := TRUE;
        bOxygenationActive       := TRUE;
        bDefoulingActive         := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive      := TRUE;

        (* Conservative operating points: reduced perfusion rate to limit risk *)
        rCmdHarvestPumpRate_L_day := (rTargetPerfusionRate_VVD * rBioreactorWorkingVol_L) * 0.75;
        rCmdFeedPumpRate_L_day    := rCmdHarvestPumpRate_L_day + rCmdBleedPumpRate_L_day;
        
        (* Fallback bleed based on historical average growth rate mu *)
        rCmdBleedPumpRate_L_day   := LIMIT(10.0, rCalculated_mu_h_inv * 24.0 * rBioreactorWorkingVol_L, 80.0);

        (* Conservative oxygenation *)
        rCmdMicroSpargeO2_sccm  := 1200.0;
        rCmdMacroSpargeAir_sccm := 4500.0;
        rCmdAgitationSpeed_RPM  := 220.0;

        IF (iVCD_HealthyChannelCount >= 2) AND (iDO_HealthyChannelCount >= 2) THEN

            iActiveState := 0;

        sActiveStateDescription := 'FAILSAFE_EMERGENCY_ABORT: Hardware safety interlock trip triggered';
        bSystemReady             := FALSE;

        bOxygenationActive       := FALSE;
        bDefoulingActive         := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive      := FALSE;

        rCmdBleedPumpRate_L_day   := 0.0;

        rCmdAcousticPower_W       := 0.0;

        rCmdMicroSpargeO2_sccm    := 0.0;

        rCmdAgitationSpeed_RPM    := 60.0;

        IF bResetAlarms AND bEStopOk AND (rAcousticChamberTemp_degC < c_rWarningChamberTemp_degC) AND (rHeadspacePressure_mbar < 50.0) THEN
